summary: Iteration 8 backend + frontend validation. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass (creator metadata on /orders, complete-service happy path + 400 path, asesor-created visibility, postventa + history-by-plate, cutting auto-deduct, inventory alerts). Frontend: /service-orders shows 'Agendó: <nombre>' (59 hits) — feature WORKS. /appointments shows ZERO 'Asesor:' tags despite backend returning created_by_name for every order: root cause is mismatch between seed orders' time_slot (legacy '08-12') and slots config (franja_1/franja_2/franja_3). /inventory, /checkin (Panorámico + percentages reachable), /postventa, /technician all load. Discovered backend bug: OrderResponse omits service_completion_photos & service_completion_notes — photos stored but never returned to UI.

critical.issue: OrderResponse does NOT declare 'service_completion_photos' or 'service_completion_notes', so the photos persisted by POST /api/orders/complete-service are dropped from every GET. UI cannot show completion photos.

ui_bugs.issue: acc[slot.id] = orders.filter(o => o.time_slot === slot.id) — seed/legacy orders for today have time_slot='08-12' but slots config returns ids franja_1/franja_2/franja_3, so every slot shows 'Sin citas agendadas' and the asesor-tag block (line 1213-1218) is never rendered. Backend payload IS correct (created_by_name present in 21/21 orders today). Fix path: either backfill order.time_slot values to franja_X or relax the filter (map old codes -> new ids).

passed_tests: pytest TestCompleteService::test_complete_service_releases_bahia_and_changes_status (status en_proceso->servicio_completado, bahia released, technician_notes persisted)
pytest TestCuttingAutoDeduct::test_complete_cutting_deducts_meters (rollo metros_restantes decremented by meters_used=3 on PUT /cutting/{id}/complete)
/service-orders (admin): 'Agendó:' label appears 59 times across kanban cards
/postventa (asesor): page loads with Buscar Vehículo por Placa input + Buscar Historial button
action_items: [HIGH] Add 'service_completion_photos: Optional[List[str]] = []' and 'service_completion_notes: Optional[str] = None' to OrderResponse in /app/backend/server.py (~L245-315). Otherwise the photos uploaded by técnico cannot be displayed anywhere in the UI.

[HIGH] /appointments asesor tag invisibility — root cause is time_slot mismatch on legacy/seed orders ('08-12' vs 'franja_1/2/3'). Run a one-shot backfill on existing orders, OR map legacy slot codes to franja_X inside Appointments.jsx ordersBySlot computation (line 420). The created_by_name field IS present in /api/orders payload; tag rendering code (line 1213) is correct.

[MED] /technician: could not validate the completion dialog end-to-end because no en_proceso order existed for the seeded técnico user during this run. Create a seed in_proceso order for QA before next regression. Backend complete-service flow itself is verified by pytest.

[LOW] PUT /cutting/{id}/complete order_history entry hardcodes details={'measurements': measurements, 'notes': notes} using the OUTER query-param variables, not the resolved final_measurements/final_notes (server.py L2211). Logs are wrong when JSON body is used.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderResponse missing service_completion_photos / service_completion_notes — store-and-forget bug that silently drops up to 10 técnico photos per order.

Appointments.jsx ordersBySlot filter is brittle: any historical change in slot ids invalidates ALL prior orders' grouping. Suggest persisting a stable slot_code on the order or computing bucket from scheduled_time.
server.py still 2553 lines — flagged for split (same comment as iter7).
/cutting/{id}/complete order_history uses outer-scope 'measurements'/'notes' query vars instead of resolved final_measurements/final_notes (history records nulls when JSON body is used).

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 features verified; /appointments asesor-tag blocked by time_slot mismatch bug)

seed_data_creation: Test orders/postventa + 1 TEST_Rollo inventory created via API during pytest run (TEST_ prefix). No teardown — main agent may clean if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Today is 2026-06-03 per server (Wed). Slots returned by /api/slots/availability use ids franja_1/2/3; seed orders use time_slot='08-12'. Until backfill, /appointments asesor-tag assertion will be 0 even though backend payload is correct. /service-orders kanban DOES surface 'Agendó:' tags (verified 59 hits). When testing complete-service dialog in /technician, first drive a fresh order to en_proceso via API (or use the helper _drive_to_en_revision + assign + start-service in test_iteration8_features.py).
rca of the issue: Appointments asesor-tag missing: orders.filter(o => o.time_slot === slot.id) returns [] because seed orders.time_slot ='08-12' while slot.id='franja_1'. Bucket empty → slotOrders.length===0 → 'Sin citas agendadas' render path, asesor-tag JSX never reached. Repro: GET /api/orders?date=2026-06-03 → check time_slot values are all '08-12'; GET /api/slots/availability?date=2026-06-03 → slot.id all 'franja_X'. Fix: backfill order.time_slot mapping 08-12→franja_1 etc, or map legacy strings in Appointments.jsx ordersBySlot.
